confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Tbilisi and the wider Caucasus. I did not check live booking pages, menus or listings. Accommodation is less certain than restaurant prices, and July peak-season rates could run higher than these anchors. Cocktail and wine are estimated from beer: cocktail at about 2.6x the beer anchor and wine by the glass at about 1.6x, since direct knowledge of those prices is weak. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries, not a direct read of the RBA page. The summaries cite 0.6955 for 2026-10-15 as an RBA figure, but a third-party site gives 0.6947 for 2026-10-16, and one summary said the RBA statistics page showed only March 2026 data. Treat the FX value as approximate and verify it against the RBA F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is the Caucasus and Eastern European mid-sized tourist-city price level, which sits below Western European capitals and roughly in line with other regional capitals such as Yerevan and Baku. Europe is the closest region in the enum, although Georgia is transcontinental.
